S: San Dimas mall cinnamon pretzel bites
the history class field trip to the San Dimas mall

Soft pretzel bites baked deep brown, rolled in butter and cinnamon sugar, with a sweet cream cheese icing dip, straight from a food court stall. Mix 400g plain flour, 7g yeast, 1 tbsp sugar, 1 tsp salt and 250ml warm water, knead and prove 1 hour. Roll into ropes and cut into 3cm bites. Dip in 2 litres boiling water with 60g bicarb soda for 30 seconds and bake at 220C for 12 minutes. Toss in 50g melted butter, then 80g caster sugar mixed with 2 tsp cinnamon. Beat 100g cream cheese with 80g icing sugar and 2 tbsp milk for the dip.

Feta cubes and mixed olives marinated in olive oil with lemon zest, oregano and chilli, with crusty bread.
England, way back, with the princesses
Turkey drumsticks brined overnight in salt and brown sugar, roasted at 160C for 90 minutes, glazed with honey and wholegrain mustard for the last 15.
M: Chicken braised with tomato, mushrooms, garlic and white wine, the dish named for one of Napoleon's battles, with crusty bread.
So-crates, picked up in ancient Athens

Lemon, garlic and oregano chicken skewers grilled until charred, in warm pita with tzatziki, beside a chunky Greek salad with a slab of feta. Cube 800g chicken thighs and marinate 1 hour in 3 tbsp olive oil, the juice of 1 lemon, 2 crushed garlic cloves and 2 tsp dried oregano. Thread onto 8 skewers and grill 10 to 12 minutes, turning. Grate 1 cucumber, squeeze dry and mix with 200g Greek yoghurt, garlic and dill. Chop 3 tomatoes, the rest of a cucumber, half a red onion and 1 green capsicum with olives, top with 150g feta, oregano and oil. Warm 4 pita.

K: the phone booth that travels through time

Purple grape juice and lime topped with fizzing soda water over a scoop of vanilla ice cream, foaming up into a most excellent spider. Mix 600ml cold grape juice with the juice of 1 lime. Add a big scoop of vanilla ice cream to each of 4 tall glasses. Pour 150ml of the grape mix over each, then slowly top with 100ml cold soda water so it foams up. Serve straight away with long spoons and straws.

s.note: So-crates, a snack from ancient Greece
s.how: Cube 200g feta and mix with 200g mixed olives, 80ml olive oil, the zest of 1 lemon, 1 tsp dried oregano and a pinch of chilli flakes. Leave 30 minutes at room temperature and serve with 1 sliced crusty loaf.

s.note: England, way back, with the princesses
s.how: Dissolve 80g salt and 80g brown sugar in 2L water and brine 4 turkey drumsticks overnight. Pat dry and roast at 160C for 90 minutes. Brush with 3 tbsp honey mixed with 2 tbsp wholegrain mustard for the last 15 minutes.

m.how: Brown 1kg chicken thigh fillets in 2 tbsp olive oil and set aside. Soften 1 diced onion and 3 crushed garlic cloves, add 200g sliced mushrooms, 125ml white wine and a 400g can diced tomatoes. Return the chicken, simmer covered for 30 minutes, scatter with parsley and serve with crusty bread.

w.note: huge, everything on it, Napoleon's challenge
w.how: Line a long dish with 4 split bananas. Add scoops of vanilla, chocolate and strawberry ice cream down the middle. Pile on whipped cream, chocolate sauce, sprinkles, chopped nuts and cherries. Give everyone a long spoon.
